description: Frozen paired recovery protocol for an all-NVFP4 RTN pressure baseline.

development.purpose: select the RTN pressure baseline before recovery

collection.purpose: collect student-visited observations for the frozen QAD checkpoint

heldout.purpose: single final paired read after all recovery choices are frozen

smoke.purpose: fixture and server validation only; never a reported score

selection.qad_learning_rate_tie_break: If development macro success is equal, choose the lower learning rate.
selection.opd_weight_tie_break: If development macro success is equal, choose the lower OPD weight.
selection.rule: Evaluate the declared all-NVFP4 RTN pressure candidate. Freeze it when its development macro success is at least 0.05 below BF16 and at least 0.30 absolute. If it does not qualify, report that the pressure window was not reached. Choose QAD and OPD settings only from development results.

quantization_scope.weight_format: NVFP4 E2M1 with tensor-level E4M3 secondary scale
quantization_scope.selection_note: All eligible linear layers use the corrected NVFP4 RTN grid; no Hessian/GPTQ calibration is used.
